alt: En Biel i l’Elies observen un full en blanc al taulell del taller.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one single landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536×1024, for a Catalan listening-comprehension worksheet and catalogue card, printed around 80 mm wide. Input images are character appearance and drawing-style references only: image 1 Biel; image 2 Elies. Match them closely. Biel is a young boy with tousled curly brown hair, charcoal zip hoodie over cream shirt. Elies is an adult man with salt-and-pepper short curls and beard, grey shirt and tan workshop apron. Scene: inside an instrument-repair workshop, Biel has placed a large completely blank sheet of paper flat on a wooden workbench. He lightly holds an edge flat while talking to Elies, who leans forward to look at it with a patient expression and an open hand. A few softly suggested instrument silhouettes establish the workshop. Make the interaction natural and specific. Fine naturalistic ink and softly textured muted watercolor, warm paper fading into a generous pure-white border on all four edges; no frame. Warm gentle light, restrained greens, browns and greys. Single coherent scene, no panels or model-sheet poses. Do not show a bend, a crease, any mounting or reinforcing board, cut cardboard, scissors, tape, poster text, music notes, readable signage, logos, numbers, watermark, or a finished solution. Do not reveal where the poster will be hung or what it advertises. Keep hands anatomically natural, subjects large enough to read at small print size.
encoding: WebP quality 90; original composition and dimensions retained.
